past.title: Doumar’s Cruise In | Sept 2nd
past.body:
(Weekly) Doumar's cruise-in Hosted by The Mustang and Ford Association of Virginia

Wednesday, September 2nd | 6-8p

Located at Doumar's Cones & Barbecue, 1919 Monticello Ave., Norfolk.

Please join us for some cars at a weekly cruise-in every Wednesday night until it gets cold, all are invited! Bring your rides out and have some fun. They are open during these hours, so enjoy all the great eats and drinks they provide, including their amazing ice cream and handmade cones!

Be kind, clean up after yourselves, no excessive revving, and no burnouts and do not speed off when leaving their parking lot.

Hope to see you there!

past.title: Boost and Brunch VB | Aug 30th
past.body:
(Last Sun) Boost and Brunch VB

SUNDAY, August 30th | 8:30-11a

Located at Baja Coffee - 2041 Fisher Arch suite 100, Virginia Beach, VA 23456

Rev up your engines and fuel your passion for cars at our event! Whether you're a gearhead or just love seeing stunning rides, this is the place to be. Join us for a morning filled with:

Classic cars, exotic rides, and custom builds
Food & coffee to kickstart your day
Meet fellow car enthusiasts and share stories
Music, vibes, vendors, and more!

When: Every LAST Sunday of each month (April - October)
Time: 830am - 11am
Where: 2041 Fisher Arch suite 100, Virginia Beach, VA 23456

Bring your car, bring your friends, and let's make it a morning to remember. All cars, all makes, and all enthusiasts welcome!
See you there!

Sponsored by :
Skyline Sports Club of Virginia
Art of Imagery
Baja coffee co
RESPECT THE SPOT! NO SPEEDING, BURN OUTS, ETC.
Don't forget to tag us in your shots! @boostandbrunch on Instagram & follow for updates. Thanks for coming out and sharing your rides with everyone.

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!

past.title: Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In | Aug 29th
past.body:
(Weekly) Classic Cruisers Saturday Night Cruz In Presented by Classic Cruisers Car Club

Saturday, August 29th | 4:30-8p

Located at Coastal Community Church, 101 Village Ave., Yorktown.

Mark your calendar to join us for our 1st Cruise-In. Cruz-Ins will be every Saturday from Apr 25 to Oct 24.

All years and types of vehicles are welcome – If you believe it’s cool, bring it in. We are asking for a $2.00 donation per vehicle. Please consider donating more – All proceeds go to charity. Vehicles are to be parked as directed by club personnel when necessary. No bicycles, skateboards, scooters, roller blades, or anything used in a manner that could injure people or damage vehicles are allowed in the participant parking area. Please do not touch vehicles without owners’ permission. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. No horseplay is allowed with vehicles at any time. (Such as burn-outs, engine revving, car hopping, loud radios or other disruptive actions). Alcoholic beverages, illegal drugs, and firearms are prohibited. There are to be NO SALES within the participant parking area EXCEPT for pre-approved items where the sale benefits charity. We are guests here. So PLEASE either take your trash with you or use the receptacles provided. 

Listing is provided by our Partnership with Don Pablo presents Car Crazy in Tidewater!
